generated.summary: An escrow of 60,000,000 base units between buyer 5azHjgBw... and seller GYrzHeQ1..., split into three milestones, was opened on-chain. Seconds later the seller opened a VerdictMesh dispute over milestone #2 in the account's list (reported as milestone 1 in the event), covering 20,000,000 base units, posting a 5,000,000 deposit; a three-juror panel was selected.
